1	"""Parse ATETestPlan Excel template into test case data structures."""
2	
3	from typing import List, Tuple, Dict
4	from openpyxl import load_workbook
5	
6	from .excel_to_seq_model import ParsedTestCase, ParsedViParameter, ParsedVariable
7	
8	
9	class ExcelParser:
10	    """Parse ATETestPlan_V1.xls Excel template."""
11	
12	    # Column indices (1-based for openpyxl)
13	    # Sheet 1: ATE test item check list
14	    COL_STEP_NO = 1          # A: Step_No
15	    COL_STEP = 2             # B: Step (startup/main/cleanup)
16	    COL_TEST_PROJECT = 3      # C: Test project items
17	    COL_STEP_TYPE = 4        # D: step type (Action, NumericLimitTest, etc.)
18	    COL_INSTRUMENT_VI = 5     # E: instrument_vi (VI filename)
19	    COL_LIMITS = 6           # F: limits expression
20	    COL_UNIT = 7             # G: unit
21	    COL_FORMAT = 8           # H: format
22	    COL_RUN_MODE = 9         # I: run mode
23	    COL_WAIT_TIME = 10       # J: wait(s)
24	    COL_ADAPTER = 11         # K: adapter
25	    COL_ADDITIONAL_RESULTS = 12  # L: additional results
26	    COL_SETTINGS = 13        # M: PreExpr/StatusExpr/PostExpr settings
27	    COL_COMMENTS = 14        # N: comments
28	    COL_DESCRIPTION = 15      # O: Description of Test Requirements
29	    COL_INPUT_SIGNALS = 16    # P
30	    COL_OUTPUT_LOADS = 17    # Q
31	    COL_PRECONDITION = 18     # R
32	    COL_COMMAND = 19          # S: VI path (Command - manual entry)
33	    COL_TEST_POINT = 20       # T
34	    COL_USL = 21              # U
35	    COL_LSL = 22             # V
36	    COL_MEASUREMENT = 23     # W
37	    COL_PRECISION = 24        # X
38	    COL_METHOD_CHECK = 25    # Y
39	    COL_EQUIPMENT = 26       # Z
40	    COL_PARAMETER = 27        # AA
41	    COL_LOGFILE = 28          # AB
42	    COL_TE_COMMENTS = 29     # AC
43	    COL_REMARKS = 30          # AD
44	
45	    def parse(self, excel_path: str) -> Tuple[List[ParsedTestCase], List[ParsedViParameter], List[ParsedVariable]]:
46	        """Parse Excel file.
47	
48	        Returns:
49	            Tuple of (test_cases, vi_parameters, variables)
50	        """
51	        wb = load_workbook(excel_path, data_only=True)
52	
53	        # Parse Sheet 1: ATE test item check list
54	        ws1 = wb["ATE test item check list"]
55	        test_cases = self._parse_check_list_sheet(ws1)
56	
57	        # Parse Sheet 2: vi_parameter_table
58	        ws2 = wb["vi_parameter_table"]
59	        vi_params = self._parse_vi_parameter_sheet(ws2)
60	
61	        # Parse Sheet 3: Variables
62	        variables = []
63	        if "Variables" in wb.sheetnames:
64	            ws3 = wb["Variables"]
65	            variables = self._parse_variables_sheet(ws3)
66	
67	        return test_cases, vi_params, variables
68	
69	    def _parse_check_list_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedTestCase]:
70	        """Parse Sheet 1 - data starts at row 5."""
71	        test_cases = []
72	
73	        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, max_col=self.COL_REMARKS, values_only=True):
74	            step_no = row[self.COL_STEP_NO - 1]
75	            if not step_no:
76	                continue
77	
78	            instrument_vi = str(row[self.COL_INSTRUMENT_VI - 1] or "").strip()
79	            vi_path = str(row[self.COL_COMMAND - 1] or "").strip()
80	
81	            # Column S (Command) is usually empty; real VI paths come from
82	            # column E (instrument_vi).  Merge: prefer explicit vi_path,
83	            # fall back to instrument_vi.
84	            if not vi_path and instrument_vi:
85	                vi_path = instrument_vi
86	
87	            tc = ParsedTestCase(
88	                step_no=str(step_no).strip(),
89	                step_group=self._normalize_step_group(row[self.COL_STEP - 1]),
90	                test_project=str(row[self.COL_TEST_PROJECT - 1] or "").strip(),
91	                step_type=str(row[self.COL_STEP_TYPE - 1] or "Action").strip(),
92	                instrument_vi=instrument_vi,
93	                limits=str(row[self.COL_LIMITS - 1] or "").strip(),
94	                unit=str(row[self.COL_UNIT - 1] or "").strip(),
95	                format=str(row[self.COL_FORMAT - 1] or "").strip(),
96	                run_mode=str(row[self.COL_RUN_MODE - 1] or "").strip(),
97	                wait_time=str(row[self.COL_WAIT_TIME - 1] or "").strip(),
98	                adapter=str(row[self.COL_ADAPTER - 1] or "").strip(),
99	                additional_results=str(row[self.COL_ADDITIONAL_RESULTS - 1] or "").strip(),
100	                settings=str(row[self.COL_SETTINGS - 1] or "").strip(),
101	                comments=str(row[self.COL_COMMENTS - 1] or "").strip(),
102	                description=str(row[self.COL_DESCRIPTION - 1] or "").strip(),
103	                vi_path=vi_path,
104	                usl=str(row[self.COL_USL - 1] or "").strip(),
105	                lsl=str(row[self.COL_LSL - 1] or "").strip(),
106	                method_check=str(row[self.COL_METHOD_CHECK - 1] or "").strip(),
107	                equipment=str(row[self.COL_EQUIPMENT - 1] or "").strip(),
108	            )
109	            test_cases.append(tc)
110	
111	        return test_cases
112	
113	    def _parse_vi_parameter_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedViParameter]:
114	        """Parse Sheet 2 - VI parameter table.
115	
116	        Parses VI definition rows and step rows to build a complete parameter map.
117	        Structure: VI definition row (no step_no, has vi_name) followed by step rows
118	        (has step_no, no vi_name) with parameter values.
119	        """
120	        vi_params = []
121	        current_vi_name = ""
122	        current_param_names = []
123	        step_params_map = {}  # step_no -> param_values
124	
125	        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=12, values_only=True):
126	            step_no = row[0]
127	            vi_name = row[1]
128	
129	            if step_no and vi_name:
130	                # New VI entry with both step_no and vi_name
131	                # Save previous VI's step params first
132	                if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
133	                    for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
134	                        vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
135	                            step_no=sn,
136	                            instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
137	                            param_names=list(current_param_names),
138	                            param_values=pvals,
139	                        ))
140	                # Start new VI
141	                current_vi_name = str(vi_name).strip() if vi_name else ""
142	                current_param_names = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
143	                step_params_map = {}  # Reset for new VI
144	            elif not step_no and vi_name:
145	                # VI definition row - save previous VI entries first
146	                if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
147	                    for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
148	                        vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
149	                            step_no=sn,
150	                            instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
151	                            param_names=list(current_param_names),
152	                            param_values=pvals,
153	                        ))
154	                current_vi_name = str(vi_name).strip() if vi_name else ""
155	                current_param_names = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
156	                step_params_map = {}
157	            elif step_no and not vi_name:
158	                # Step row - param values (no vi_name, but has step_no)
159	                current_step_no = str(step_no).strip() if step_no else ""
160	                param_values = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
161	                step_params_map[current_step_no] = param_values
162	
163	        # Save last VI entry
164	        if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
165	            for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
166	                vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
167	                    step_no=sn,
168	                    instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
169	                    param_names=list(current_param_names),
170	                    param_values=pvals,
171	                ))
172	
173	        return vi_params
174	
175	    def _parse_variables_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedVariable]:
176	        """Parse Sheet 3 - Variables table.
177	
178	        Columns: A=Container, B=Variable Name, C=Value, D=Type
179	        Data starts at row 2.
180	        """
181	        variables = []
182	        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=4, values_only=True):
183	            container = str(row[0] or "").strip()
184	            var_name = str(row[1] or "").strip()
185	            value = str(row[2] or "").strip()
186	            var_type = str(row[3] or "").strip()
187	            if container and var_name:
188	                variables.append(ParsedVariable(
189	                    container=container,
190	                    name=var_name,
191	                    value=value,
192	                    var_type=var_type,
193	                ))
194	        return variables
195	
196	    def _normalize_step_group(self, value) -> str:
197	        """Normalize step group value."""
198	        if not value:
199	            return "main"
200	        v = str(value).lower().strip()
201	        if v in ("startup", "setup"):
202	            return "startup"
203	        if v in ("cleanup",):
204	            return "cleanup"
205	        return "main"
206	
207	
208	def group_by_parent_step(test_cases: List[ParsedTestCase]) -> Tuple[List[ParsedTestCase], Dict[str, List[ParsedTestCase]], Dict[str, str]]:
209	    """Group test cases by parent step number.
210	
211	    For step_no like "2_1_1", the parent is "2_1".
212	    For step_no like "2_1", it is a top-level step (no parent).
213	
214	    Returns:
215	        (top_level_cases, sub_sequence_groups, parent_names)
216	        where parent_names maps parent_no -> test_project name
217	    """
218	    groups = {}
219	    parent_names = {}
220	    top_level = []
221	
222	    for tc in test_cases:
223	        parts = tc.step_no.split("_")
224	        if len(parts) >= 3:
225	            # Nested step (e.g., 2_1_1) -> parent is 2_1

"""Parse ATETestPlan Excel template into test case data structures."""

from typing import List, Tuple, Dict
from openpyxl import load_workbook

from .excel_to_seq_model import ParsedTestCase, ParsedViParameter, ParsedVariable


class ExcelParser:
    """Parse ATETestPlan_V1.xls Excel template."""

    # Column indices (1-based for openpyxl)
    # Sheet 1: ATE test item check list
    COL_STEP_NO = 1          # A: Step_No
    COL_STEP = 2             # B: Step (startup/main/cleanup)
    COL_TEST_PROJECT = 3      # C: Test project items
    COL_STEP_TYPE = 4        # D: step type (Action, NumericLimitTest, etc.)
    COL_INSTRUMENT_VI = 5     # E: instrument_vi (VI filename)
    COL_LIMITS = 6           # F: limits expression
    COL_UNIT = 7             # G: unit
    COL_FORMAT = 8           # H: format
    COL_RUN_MODE = 9         # I: run mode
    COL_WAIT_TIME = 10       # J: wait(s)
    COL_ADAPTER = 11         # K: adapter
    COL_ADDITIONAL_RESULTS = 12  # L: additional results
    COL_SETTINGS = 13        # M: PreExpr/StatusExpr/PostExpr settings
    COL_COMMENTS = 14        # N: comments
    COL_DESCRIPTION = 15      # O: Description of Test Requirements
    COL_INPUT_SIGNALS = 16    # P
    COL_OUTPUT_LOADS = 17    # Q
    COL_PRECONDITION = 18     # R
    COL_COMMAND = 19          # S: VI path (Command - manual entry)
    COL_TEST_POINT = 20       # T
    COL_USL = 21              # U
    COL_LSL = 22             # V
    COL_MEASUREMENT = 23     # W
    COL_PRECISION = 24        # X
    COL_METHOD_CHECK = 25    # Y
    COL_EQUIPMENT = 26       # Z
    COL_PARAMETER = 27        # AA
    COL_LOGFILE = 28          # AB
    COL_TE_COMMENTS = 29     # AC
    COL_REMARKS = 30          # AD

    def parse(self, excel_path: str) -> Tuple[List[ParsedTestCase], List[ParsedViParameter], List[ParsedVariable]]:
        """Parse Excel file.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (test_cases, vi_parameters, variables)
        """
        wb = load_workbook(excel_path, data_only=True)

        # Parse Sheet 1: ATE test item check list
        ws1 = wb["ATE test item check list"]
        test_cases = self._parse_check_list_sheet(ws1)

        # Parse Sheet 2: vi_parameter_table
        ws2 = wb["vi_parameter_table"]
        vi_params = self._parse_vi_parameter_sheet(ws2)

        # Parse Sheet 3: Variables
        variables = []
        if "Variables" in wb.sheetnames:
            ws3 = wb["Variables"]
            variables = self._parse_variables_sheet(ws3)

        return test_cases, vi_params, variables

    def _parse_check_list_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedTestCase]:
        """Parse Sheet 1 - data starts at row 5."""
        test_cases = []

        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, max_col=self.COL_REMARKS, values_only=True):
            step_no = row[self.COL_STEP_NO - 1]
            if not step_no:
                continue

            instrument_vi = str(row[self.COL_INSTRUMENT_VI - 1] or "").strip()
            vi_path = str(row[self.COL_COMMAND - 1] or "").strip()

            # Column S (Command) is usually empty; real VI paths come from
            # column E (instrument_vi).  Merge: prefer explicit vi_path,
            # fall back to instrument_vi.
            if not vi_path and instrument_vi:
                vi_path = instrument_vi

            tc = ParsedTestCase(
                step_no=str(step_no).strip(),
                step_group=self._normalize_step_group(row[self.COL_STEP - 1]),
                test_project=str(row[self.COL_TEST_PROJECT - 1] or "").strip(),
                step_type=str(row[self.COL_STEP_TYPE - 1] or "Action").strip(),
                instrument_vi=instrument_vi,
                limits=str(row[self.COL_LIMITS - 1] or "").strip(),
                unit=str(row[self.COL_UNIT - 1] or "").strip(),
                format=str(row[self.COL_FORMAT - 1] or "").strip(),
                run_mode=str(row[self.COL_RUN_MODE - 1] or "").strip(),
                wait_time=str(row[self.COL_WAIT_TIME - 1] or "").strip(),
                adapter=str(row[self.COL_ADAPTER - 1] or "").strip(),
                additional_results=str(row[self.COL_ADDITIONAL_RESULTS - 1] or "").strip(),
                settings=str(row[self.COL_SETTINGS - 1] or "").strip(),
                comments=str(row[self.COL_COMMENTS - 1] or "").strip(),
                description=str(row[self.COL_DESCRIPTION - 1] or "").strip(),
                vi_path=vi_path,
                usl=str(row[self.COL_USL - 1] or "").strip(),
                lsl=str(row[self.COL_LSL - 1] or "").strip(),
                method_check=str(row[self.COL_METHOD_CHECK - 1] or "").strip(),
                equipment=str(row[self.COL_EQUIPMENT - 1] or "").strip(),
            )
            test_cases.append(tc)

        return test_cases

    def _parse_vi_parameter_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedViParameter]:
        """Parse Sheet 2 - VI parameter table.

        Parses VI definition rows and step rows to build a complete parameter map.
        Structure: VI definition row (no step_no, has vi_name) followed by step rows
        (has step_no, no vi_name) with parameter values.
        """
        vi_params = []
        current_vi_name = ""
        current_param_names = []
        step_params_map = {}  # step_no -> param_values

        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=12, values_only=True):
            step_no = row[0]
            vi_name = row[1]

            if step_no and vi_name:
                # New VI entry with both step_no and vi_name
                # Save previous VI's step params first
                if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
                    for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
                        vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
                            step_no=sn,
                            instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
                            param_names=list(current_param_names),
                            param_values=pvals,
                        ))
                # Start new VI
                current_vi_name = str(vi_name).strip() if vi_name else ""
                current_param_names = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
                step_params_map = {}  # Reset for new VI
            elif not step_no and vi_name:
                # VI definition row - save previous VI entries first
                if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
                    for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
                        vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
                            step_no=sn,
                            instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
                            param_names=list(current_param_names),
                            param_values=pvals,
                        ))
                current_vi_name = str(vi_name).strip() if vi_name else ""
                current_param_names = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
                step_params_map = {}
            elif step_no and not vi_name:
                # Step row - param values (no vi_name, but has step_no)
                current_step_no = str(step_no).strip() if step_no else ""
                param_values = [str(row[i] or "").strip() for i in range(2, 12)]
                step_params_map[current_step_no] = param_values

        # Save last VI entry
        if current_vi_name and step_params_map:
            for sn, pvals in step_params_map.items():
                vi_params.append(ParsedViParameter(
                    step_no=sn,
                    instrument_vi_name=current_vi_name,
                    param_names=list(current_param_names),
                    param_values=pvals,
                ))

        return vi_params

    def _parse_variables_sheet(self, ws) -> List[ParsedVariable]:
        """Parse Sheet 3 - Variables table.

        Columns: A=Container, B=Variable Name, C=Value, D=Type
        Data starts at row 2.
        """
        variables = []
        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=4, values_only=True):
            container = str(row[0] or "").strip()
            var_name = str(row[1] or "").strip()
            value = str(row[2] or "").strip()
            var_type = str(row[3] or "").strip()
            if container and var_name:
                variables.append(ParsedVariable(
                    container=container,
                    name=var_name,
                    value=value,
                    var_type=var_type,
                ))
        return variables

    def _normalize_step_group(self, value) -> str:
        """Normalize step group value."""
        if not value:
            return "main"
        v = str(value).lower().strip()
        if v in ("startup", "setup"):
            return "startup"
        if v in ("cleanup",):
            return "cleanup"
        return "main"


def group_by_parent_step(test_cases: List[ParsedTestCase]) -> Tuple[List[ParsedTestCase], Dict[str, List[ParsedTestCase]], Dict[str, str]]:
    """Group test cases by parent step number.

    For step_no like "2_1_1", the parent is "2_1".
    For step_no like "2_1", it is a top-level step (no parent).

    Returns:
        (top_level_cases, sub_sequence_groups, parent_names)
        where parent_names maps parent_no -> test_project name
    """
    groups = {}
    parent_names = {}
    top_level = []

    for tc in test_cases:
        parts = tc.step_no.split("_")
        if len(parts) >= 3:
            # Nested step (e.g., 2_1_1) -> parent is 2_1
            parent_no = "_".join(parts[:2])
            if parent_no not in groups:
                groups[parent_no] = []
                parent_names[parent_no] = tc.test_project
            groups[parent_no].append(tc)
        else:
            # Top-level step
            top_level.append(tc)

    return top_level, groups, parent_names


def parse_step_no(step_no: str) -> Tuple[str, int, int]:
    """Parse step number into components.

    Returns:
        (prefix, main_idx, sub_idx) - e.g., "2_1_3" -> ("2", 1, 3)
    """
    parts = step_no.split("_")
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return parts[0], int(parts[1]), 0
    elif len(parts) >= 3:
        return parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
    return "2", 0, 0

42	class SeqGenerator:
43	    """Generate TestStand .seq file from parsed Excel test cases."""
44	
45	    ADAPTER_LV = "G Flexible VI Adapter"
46	    ADAPTER_NONE = "None Adapter"
47	    ADAPTER_SEQUENCE = "Sequence Adapter"
48	    ADAPTER_AUTOMATION = "Automation Adapter"
49	    ADAPTER_DLL = "DLL Flexible Prototype Adapter"
50	    STEP_TYPE_ACTION = "Action"
51	
52	    def __init__(self):
53	        self._engine = None
54	
55	    def generate(self, test_cases: List[ParsedTestCase],
56	                vi_params: List[ParsedViParameter],
57	                output_path: str,
58	                sequence_name: str = "MainSequence",
59	                variables: List[ParsedVariable] = None) -> None:
60	        """Generate sequence file from test cases.
61	
62	        Creates separate sub-sequences for nested steps (e.g. 2_4_1 -> parent 2_4).
63	        Each sub-sequence group becomes its own sequence, and the parent step
64	        in the main sequence becomes a SequenceCall step.
65	        """
66	        self._engine = TestStandEngine()
67	
68	        with self._engine:
69	            self._engine.create_new_file(output_path)
70	
71	            # Build VI param lookup by step_no
72	            vi_param_map = self._build_vi_param_map(vi_params)
73	
74	            # Separate top-level from nested (sub-sequence) steps
75	            top_level, sub_sequence_groups, parent_names = group_by_parent_step(test_cases)
76	
77	            # Build lookup: parent_no -> parent ParsedTestCase
78	            parent_case_map = {tc.step_no: tc for tc in top_level}
79	
80	            # Create sub-sequences FIRST (they need to exist before SequenceCall can reference them)
81	            for parent_no, child_cases in sub_sequence_groups.items():
82	                parent_tc = parent_case_map.get(parent_no)
83	                seq_name = parent_tc.test_project if parent_tc else f"SubSeq_{parent_no}"
84	                self._create_sub_sequence(seq_name, child_cases, vi_param_map)
85	
86	            # Create main sequence (auto-created with NewSequenceFile)
87	            if self._engine.sequence_file.NumSequences > 0:
88	                main_seq = self._engine.sequence_file.GetSequence(0)
89	                main_seq.Name = sequence_name
90	            else:
91	                main_seq = self._engine.engine.NewSequence()
92	                main_seq.Name = sequence_name
93	                self._engine.sequence_file.InsertSequenceEx(0, main_seq)
94	
95	            # Create top-level steps in main sequence - route each to its proper group
96	            from collections import defaultdict
97	            by_group = defaultdict(list)
98	            for tc in top_level:
99	                by_group[tc.step_group].append(tc)
100	            for group_name, group_cases in by_group.items():
101	                self._create_steps_in_sequence(main_seq, group_cases, vi_param_map, group_name,
102	                                               sub_sequence_groups=sub_sequence_groups)
103	
104	            # Create variables (FileGlobals and Locals)
105	            if variables:
106	                self._create_variables(variables)
107	
108	            self._engine.save_file(output_path)
109	
110	    def _build_vi_param_map(self, vi_params: List[ParsedViParameter]) -> Dict[str, ParsedViParameter]:
111	        """Build lookup map for VI parameters by step_no."""
112	        return {vp.step_no: vp for vp in vi_params}
113	
114	    # PropertyValueTypes constants
115	    PROP_TYPE_CONTAINER = 0
116	    PROP_TYPE_STRING = 1
117	    PROP_TYPE_BOOLEAN = 2
118	    PROP_TYPE_NUMBER = 3
119	
120	    def _prop_type_from_str(self, type_str: str) -> int:
121	        """Convert type string to PropertyValueTypes constant."""
122	        t = type_str.lower()
123	        if t == "string":
124	            return self.PROP_TYPE_STRING
125	        if t == "boolean":
126	            return self.PROP_TYPE_BOOLEAN
127	        if t == "number":
128	            return self.PROP_TYPE_NUMBER
129	        # Array and others default to container
130	        return self.PROP_TYPE_CONTAINER
131	
132	    def _set_prop_value(self, container, name: str, value: str, var_type: str) -> None:
133	        """Set a property value on a PropertyObject container."""
134	        try:
135	            t = var_type.lower()
136	            if t == "number":
137	                container.SetValNumber(name, 0, float(value))
138	            elif t == "boolean":
139	                container.SetValBoolean(name, 0, value.lower() == "true")
140	            elif t == "string":
141	                container.SetValString(name, 0, value)
142	        except Exception:
143	            pass
144	
145	    def _create_variables(self, variables: List[ParsedVariable]) -> None:
146	        """Create FileGlobals and Locals variables in the sequence file."""
147	        file_globals = []
148	        locals_groups = {}  # seq_name -> [ParsedVariable, ...]
149	
150	        for v in variables:
151	            if v.container == "FileGlobals":
152	                file_globals.append(v)
153	            elif v.container.startswith("Locals."):
154	                seq_name = v.container[7:]
155	                locals_groups.setdefault(seq_name, []).append(v)
156	
157	        # Create FileGlobals
158	        if file_globals:
159	            try:
160	                fg = self._engine.sequence_file.FileGlobalsDefaultValues
161	                for v in file_globals:
162	                    value_type = self._prop_type_from_str(v.var_type)
163	                    is_array = v.var_type.lower() == "array"
164	                    try:
165	                        fg.NewSubProperty(v.name, value_type, is_array, "", 0)
166	                    except Exception:
167	                        pass
168	                    if not is_array and v.value:
169	                        self._set_prop_value(fg, v.name, v.value, v.var_type)
170	                del fg
171	            except Exception:
172	                pass
173	
174	        # Create Locals — match by sequence name
175	        if locals_groups:
176	            try:
177	                num_seqs = self._engine.sequence_file.NumSequences
178	                for seq_idx in range(num_seqs):
179	                    seq = self._engine.sequence_file.GetSequence(seq_idx)
180	                    seq_name = seq.Name
181	                    if seq_name in locals_groups:
182	                        try:
183	                            loc = seq.Locals
184	                            for v in locals_groups[seq_name]:
185	                                value_type = self._prop_type_from_str(v.var_type)
186	                                is_array = v.var_type.lower() == "array"
187	                                try:
188	                                    loc.NewSubProperty(v.name, value_type, is_array, "", 0)
189	                                except Exception:
190	                                    pass
191	                                if not is_array and v.value:
192	                                    self._set_prop_value(loc, v.name, v.value, v.var_type)
193	                            del loc
194	                        except Exception:
195	                            pass
196	                    del seq
197	            except Exception:
198	                pass
199	
200	    def _create_sub_sequence(self, seq_name: str, cases: List[ParsedTestCase],
201	                             vi_param_map: Dict[str, ParsedViParameter]) -> None:
202	        """Create a sub-sequence for a group of child steps."""
203	        sub_seq = self._engine.engine.NewSequence()
204	        sub_seq.Name = seq_name
205	
206	        # Insert at end of sequence file
207	        insert_pos = self._engine.sequence_file.NumSequences
208	        self._engine.sequence_file.InsertSequenceEx(insert_pos, sub_seq)
209	        # After InsertSequenceEx, sub_seq belongs to the file - don't del it
210	
211	        # Group child cases by step group and route each to its proper group
212	        by_group = self._group_cases_by_step_group(cases)
213	        for group_name, group_cases in by_group.items():
214	            if group_cases:
215	                self._create_steps_in_sequence(sub_seq, group_cases, vi_param_map, group_name)
216	
217	    def _create_steps_in_sequence(self, sequence, cases: List[ParsedTestCase],
218	                                  vi_param_map: Dict[str, ParsedViParameter],
219	                                  group_name: str,
220	                                  sub_sequence_groups: Dict[str, List[ParsedTestCase]] = None) -> None:
221	        """Create steps within a sequence.
222	
223	        For top-level steps that have sub-sequence children, creates a SequenceCall
224	        step instead of an Action step.
225	        """
226	        api_group = STEP_GROUP_API[self._group_name_to_idx(group_name)]
227	        count = sequence.GetNumSteps(api_group)
228	
229	        for tc in cases:
230	            step = None
231	            try:
232	                # Check if this step has sub-sequence children
233	                if sub_sequence_groups and len(tc.step_no.split("_")) == 2:
234	                    parent_no = tc.step_no
235	                    if parent_no in sub_sequence_groups:
236	                        # Create SequenceCall step to call the sub-sequence
237	                        step = self._create_sequence_call_step(tc, parent_no)
238	                    else:
239	                        step = self._create_normal_step(tc, vi_param_map)
240	                else:
241	                    step = self._create_normal_step(tc, vi_param_map)
242	
243	                # Mark step as skipped if run_mode is "Skip"
244	                if tc.run_mode.lower() == "skip":
245	                    try:
246	                        prop = step.AsPropertyObject()
247	                        prop.SetValString("TS.Mode", 0, "Skip")
248	                        del prop
249	                    except Exception:
250	                        pass
251	
252	                sequence.InsertStep(step, count, api_group)
253	                self._engine.sequence_file.IncChangeCount()
254	                count += 1
255	            except Exception as e:
256	                print(f"Warning: failed to create step {tc.step_no} ({tc.test_project}): {e}")
257	            finally:
258	                if step is not None:
259	                    del step
260	
261	    def _create_normal_step(self, tc: ParsedTestCase, vi_param_map: Dict[str, ParsedViParameter] = None):
262	        """Create a normal (non-SequenceCall) step."""
263	        adapter = self._get_adapter_for_step(tc)
264	        step = self._engine.engine.NewStep(adapter, tc.step_type)
265	        step.Name = tc.test_project
266	
267	        # Set comment from comments field, or fallback to description
268	        comment = tc.comments if tc.comments else tc.description
269	        if comment:
270	            step.Comment = comment
271	
272	        # Register type with the file's type usage list
273	        self._engine.sequence_file.AsPropertyObjectFile().TypeUsageList.AddUsedTypes(
274	            step.AsPropertyObject()
275	        )
276	
277	        # Build effective settings (merge additional_results column into settings)
278	        effective_settings = tc.settings
279	        if tc.additional_results:
280	            ar_part = tc.additional_results
281	            if ar_part.startswith("AR.Parms["):
282	                if effective_settings:
283	                    effective_settings = effective_settings + "; " + ar_part
284	                else:
285	                    effective_settings = ar_part
286	            elif not effective_settings or "AdditionalResults=" not in effective_settings:
287	                effective_settings = (effective_settings + "; " if effective_settings else "") + "AdditionalResults=" + ar_part
288	
289	        # Set VI path if applicable
290	        if tc.vi_path and adapter != self.ADAPTER_NONE:
291	            self._set_module_vi_path(step, tc.vi_path, tc.step_no, vi_param_map, effective_settings, tc.adapter)
292	
293	        # Apply step-type-specific properties (pass effective_settings for AR processing)
294	        self._apply_step_properties(step, tc, effective_settings)
295	
296	        return step
297	
298	    def _create_sequence_call_step(self, tc: ParsedTestCase, parent_no: str):
299	        """Create a SequenceCall step that calls a sub-sequence."""
300	        step = self._engine.engine.NewStep("Sequence Adapter", "SequenceCall")
301	        step.Name = tc.test_project
302	        if tc.description:
303	            step.Comment = tc.description
304	
305	        # Register type
306	        self._engine.sequence_file.AsPropertyObjectFile().TypeUsageList.AddUsedTypes(
307	            step.AsPropertyObject()
308	        )
309	
310	        # Set which sequence to call via TS.SData.SeqName
311	        try:
312	            prop_obj = step.AsPropertyObject()
313	            ts = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("TS", 0)

484	    def _set_activex_call_parameters(self, prop_obj, vi_param: ParsedViParameter) -> None:

486

491	            ts = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("TS", 0)
492	            if not ts:
493	                return

495	            if not sdata:
496	                del ts

498	            call = sdata.GetPropertyObject("Call", 0)
499	            if not call:
500	                del sdata
501	                del ts
502	                return
503	
504	            # Filter out empty parameter names
505	            valid_params = [(n, v) for n, v in zip(vi_param.param_names, vi_param.param_values) if n]
506	
507	            params = call.GetPropertyObject("Parameters", 0)
508	            if params:
509	                count = params.GetNumElements()
510	                if count == 0 and valid_params:
511	                    # Parameters container is empty - create entries

513	                    for i, (name, value) in enumerate(valid_params):
514	                        try:
515	                            elem = params.GetPropertyObject(f"[{i}]", 0)
516	                            if elem:

520	                                    elem.SetValString("ArgVal", 0, final_value)

529	                            if elem:

533	                                    value = vi_param.param_values[idx]
534	                                    if value:
535	                                        final_value = self._format_activex_param_value(value)
536	                                        elem.SetValString("ArgVal", 0, final_value)
537	                                del elem
538	                        except Exception:
539	                            pass
540	                del params
541	
542	            del call

548	    def _format_activex_param_value(self, value: str) -> str:
549	        """Format an ActiveX parameter value with appropriate quoting."""
550	        if value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
551	            return value
552	        # TestStand expression prefixes — never quote these
553	        for prefix in ('RunState.', 'FileGlobals.', 'Locals.', 'Step.', 'ThisContext'):
554	            if value.startswith(prefix):
555	                return value
556	        if value in ('True', 'False'):
557	            return value
558	        if value.replace('.', '').replace('-', '').isdigit():
559	            return value
560	        # Expressions containing operators — not string literals
561	        if any(op in value for op in ('+', '-', '*', '/', '(', ')', '%')):
562	            return value
563	        return f'"{value}"'

565	    def _set_activex_params_via_module(self, step, vi_param: ParsedViParameter) -> bool:
566	        """Set ActiveX parameters via ActiveXModule.Parameters API.
567	
568	        Uses dynamic Dispatch on step.Module to access ActiveXModule interface,
569	        calls LoadPrototype, then sets ActiveXParameter.ValueExpr for matched parameters.
570	        Returns True if successful, False to trigger fallback.
571	        """
572	        try:
573	            module = step.Module
574	            if module is None:
575	                return False
576	            mod_dyn = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(module._oleobj_)
577	            mod_dyn.LoadPrototype(0)
578	            params = mod_dyn.Parameters
579	            if not params or params.Count == 0:
580	                del module
581	                return False
582	
583	            for i in range(params.Count):
584	                try:
585	                    item = params.Item(i)
586	                    item_dyn = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(item._oleobj_)
587	                    param_name = item_dyn.ParameterName or ""
588	
589	                    matched_idx = -1
590	                    if param_name in vi_param.param_names:
591	                        matched_idx = vi_param.param_names.index(param_name)
592	
593	                    if matched_idx >= 0:
594	                        value = vi_param.param_values[matched_idx]
595	                        if value:
596	                            final_value = self._format_activex_param_value(value)
597	                            item_dyn.UseDefault = False
598	                            item_dyn.ValueExpr = final_value
599	                except Exception:
600	                    pass
601	
602	            del module
603	            return True
604	        except Exception:
605	            return False

607	    def _search_vi_near_seq_file(self, vi_path: str) -> Optional[str]:
608	        """Search for VI file near the sequence file location.
609	
610	        Handles encoded/corrupted paths and relative paths.
611	        """
612	        if not vi_path or not self._engine or not self._engine.current_file_path:
613	            return None
614	
615	        # Extract VI filename from path
616	        if ".vi" not in vi_path.lower():
617	            return None
618	
619	        vi_filename = None
620	        parts = vi_path.replace("/", os.sep).split(os.sep)
621	        for part in reversed(parts):
622	            if ".vi" in part.lower():
623	                vi_filename = part
624	                break
625	
626	        if not vi_filename:
627	            return None
628	
629	        # Search near sequence file location
630	        search_base = os.path.dirname(self._engine.current_file_path)
631	        if not search_base:
632	            return None
633	
634	        return self._search_for_vi_impl(search_base, vi_filename, max_depth=5)

636	    def _search_for_vi_impl(self, base_dir: str, vi_filename: str, max_depth: int, current_depth: int = 0) -> Optional[str]:
637	        """Recursively search for VI file with depth limit."""
638	        if current_depth > max_depth:
639	            return None
640	
641	        if not os.path.isdir(base_dir):
642	            return None
643	
644	        # Check current directory
645	        try:
646	            files = os.listdir(base_dir)
647	            if vi_filename in files:
648	                return os.path.join(base_dir, vi_filename)
649	        except PermissionError:
650	            return None
651	
652	        # Check subdirectories with common VI folder names
653	        vi_subdirs = ["VIs for U-1 Test module", "Sub VIs", "VIs", "Modules", "LabVIEW VIs"]
654	
655	        try:
656	            dirs = os.listdir(base_dir)
657	            for d in dirs:
658	                if d in vi_subdirs:
659	                    subdir = os.path.join(base_dir, d)
660	                    if os.path.isdir(subdir):
661	                        result = self._search_for_vi_impl(subdir, vi_filename, max_depth, current_depth + 1)
662	                        if result:
663	                            return result
664	        except PermissionError:
665	            pass
666	
667	        return None

669	    def _set_vi_parameters(self, module, vi_param: ParsedViParameter) -> None:
670	        """Set VI parameters from ParsedViParameter.
671	
672	        Uses LabVIEWModule.Parameters to set parameter value expressions.
673	        Must call LoadPrototype before accessing parameters.
674	        Per API docs, UseDefaultValue must be False for ValueExpr to be used.
675	
676	        Note: param_names from Excel may match either ParameterName or ParameterCaption.
677	        For enum parameters, GetEnumValues() returns valid constant names - use these directly.
678	        For string parameters with embedded quotes (from Excel display), strip outer quotes.
679	        """
680	        try:
681	            # Get the LabVIEW parameters collection
682	            params = module.Parameters
683	            if params is None:
684	                return
685	
686	            count = params.Count
687	            # Match parameters by name or caption and set value expression
688	            for i in range(count):
689	                param = params.Item(i)
690	                if param is None:
691	                    continue
692	
693	                param_name = param.ParameterName
694	                param_caption = param.ParameterCaption if hasattr(param, 'ParameterCaption') else ""
695	
696	                # Find matching parameter - try name first, then caption
697	                matched_idx = -1
698	                if param_name and param_name in vi_param.param_names:
699	                    matched_idx = vi_param.param_names.index(param_name)
700	                elif param_caption and param_caption in vi_param.param_names:
701	                    matched_idx = vi_param.param_names.index(param_caption)
702	
703	                if matched_idx >= 0:
704	                    value = vi_param.param_values[matched_idx]
705	                    if value:
706	                        # Output parameters are always expressions — never quote them.
707	                        # Input parameters: quote string literals, but not expressions/numbers/booleans.
708	                        direction = int(param.Direction) if hasattr(param, 'Direction') else 0
709	                        if direction == 1:  # Output
710	                            needs_quotes = False
711	                        else:  # Input or Input/Output
712	                            needs_quotes = True
713	                            if value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
714	                                needs_quotes = False  # Already quoted from Excel
715	                            elif value.startswith('RunState.') or value.startswith('FileGlobals.') or value.startswith('Step.') or value.startswith('Locals.'):
716	                                needs_quotes = False  # TestStand expressions
717	                            elif value in ('True', 'False'):
718	                                needs_quotes = False  # Boolean
719	                            elif value.replace('.', '').replace('-', '').isdigit():
720	                                needs_quotes = False  # Numeric
721	
722	                        final_value = f'"{value}"' if needs_quotes else value
723	
724	                        # Per API docs: UseDefaultValue must be False for ValueExpr to be used
725	                        param.UseDefaultValue = False
726	                        param.ValueExpr = final_value
727	                del param
728	            del params
729	        except Exception:
730	            pass

732	    def _apply_vi_param_additional_results(self, module, settings: str) -> None:
733	        """Apply VI parameter-level AdditionalResult.CheckedState from settings.
734	
735	        Parses AR entries like: AR.Parms[4](Data out).CheckedState=2
736	        Matches parameters by label (e.g., "Data out") and sets CheckedState
737	        on the module parameter's AdditionalResult sub-property.
738	        """
739	        # Parse AR entries from settings
740	        ar_entries = []  # [(label, checked_state), ...]
741	        for part in settings.split(';'):
742	            part = part.strip()
743	            if part.startswith('AR.Parms[') and '.CheckedState=' in part:
744	                match = re.match(r'AR\.Parms\[\d+\]\(([^)]+)\)\.CheckedState=(\d+)', part)
745	                if match:
746	                    label = match.group(1)
747	                    checked_state = int(match.group(2))
748	                    ar_entries.append((label, checked_state))
749	
750	        if not ar_entries:
751	            return
752	
753	        try:
754	            params = module.Parameters
755	            if params is None:
756	                return
757	
758	            count = params.Count
759	            for i in range(count):
760	                param = params.Item(i)
761	                if param is None:
762	                    continue
763	
764	                param_name = param.ParameterName or ""
765	                param_caption = ""
766	                try:
767	                    param_caption = param.ParameterCaption or ""
768	                except Exception:
769	                    pass
770	
771	                for label, checked_state in ar_entries:
772	                    if label == param_name or label == param_caption:
773	                        try:
774	                            ar = param.GetPropertyObject("AdditionalResult", 0)
775	                            if ar:
776	                                ar.SetValNumber("CheckedState", 0, checked_state)
777	                                del ar
778	                        except Exception:
779	                            pass
780	                        break
781	
782	                del param
783	            del params
784	        except Exception:
785	            pass

812	    def _apply_numeric_limits(self, prop_obj, limits_str: str, unit_str: str = "", format_str: str = "") -> None:
813	        """Parse and apply NumericLimitTest limits.
814	
815	        Args:
816	            prop_obj: Step property object
817	            limits_str: Limit expression (e.g., "4.50<=x<=5.50", "x==0xaa")
818	            unit_str: Unit string (e.g., "Vdc", "VAC")
819	            format_str: Numeric format (e.g., "%.2f", "%u", "%#x")
820	        """
821	        limits_str = limits_str.strip()
822	        if not limits_str:
823	            return
824	
825	        # Extract numeric values from the expression
826	        nums = re.findall(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|[-+]?\d*\.?\d+", limits_str)
827	        nums_converted = []
828	        for n in nums:
829	            if n.startswith('0x') or n.startswith('0X'):
830	                nums_converted.append(int(n, 16))
831	            else:
832	                nums_converted.append(float(n) if n else 0.0)
833	
834	        if not nums_converted:
835	            return
836	
837	        # Determine low/high values
838	        expr_only = limits_str
839	        if "<=x<=" in expr_only or "<=x<=" in limits_str.replace(" ", ""):
840	            if len(nums_converted) >= 2:
841	                low_val, high_val = nums_converted[0], nums_converted[1]
842	            else:
843	                low_val, high_val = nums_converted[0], nums_converted[0]
844	        elif "x==" in expr_only or "x==" in limits_str:
845	            val = nums_converted[0] if nums_converted else 0
846	            low_val, high_val = val, val
847	        elif "x<" in expr_only or "x<" in limits_str:
848	            high_val = nums_converted[0] if nums_converted else 0
849	            low_val = float('-inf')
850	        elif "x>" in expr_only or "x>" in limits_str:
851	            low_val = nums_converted[0] if nums_converted else 0
852	            high_val = float('inf')
853	        else:
854	            low_val, high_val = nums_converted[0], nums_converted[0]
855	
856	        try:
857	            prop_obj.SetValNumber("Limits.Low", 0, low_val)
858	        except Exception:
859	            pass
860	        try:
861	            prop_obj.SetValNumber("Limits.High", 0, high_val)
862	        except Exception:
863	            pass
864	        # For x== comparison, set Comp to 'EQ' (equality)
865	        if "x==" in expr_only or "x==" in limits_str:
866	            try:
867	                prop_obj.SetValString("Comp", 0, "EQ")
868	            except Exception:
869	                pass
870	
871	        # Set Units if present - must be set via Result.Units (not Limits.Units)
872	        if unit_str:
873	            try:
874	                prop_obj.SetValString("Result.Units", 0, unit_str)
875	            except Exception:
876	                pass
877	            try:
878	                result = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("Result", 0)
879	                result.SetValString("Units", 0, unit_str)
880	                del result
881	            except Exception:
882	                pass
883	
884	        # Set NumericFormat if present - must be set via Limits.High, Limits.Low, and Result.Numeric
885	        # per StepProperties.md: "set the numeric format using PropertyObject.NumericFormat property
886	        # of the following step properties: Limits.High, Limits.Low, and Result.Numeric"
887	        if format_str:
888	            # Set on Limits.High
889	            try:
890	                limits_high = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("Limits.High", 0)
891	                if limits_high:
892	                    limits_high.NumericFormat = format_str
893	                    del limits_high
894	            except Exception:
895	                pass
896	            try:
897	                prop_obj.SetValString("Limits.High.NumericFormat", 0, format_str)
898	            except Exception:
899	                pass
900	
901	            # Set on Limits.Low
902	            try:
903	                limits_low = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("Limits.Low", 0)
904	                if limits_low:
905	                    limits_low.NumericFormat = format_str
906	                    del limits_low
907	            except Exception:
908	                pass
909	            try:
910	                prop_obj.SetValString("Limits.Low.NumericFormat", 0, format_str)
911	            except Exception:
912	                pass
913	
914	            # Set on Result.Numeric
915	            try:
916	                result_num = prop_obj.GetPropertyObject("Result.Numeric", 0)
917	                if result_num:

"""CLI entry point for Excel to TestStand sequence file converter."""
import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from .excel_parser import ExcelParser
from .seq_generator import SeqGenerator


def create_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert ATETestPlan Excel template to NI TestStand sequence file",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog="""
Examples:
  # Convert Excel template to sequence file
  python -m teststand.agents.excel_to_seq "D:\\Templates\\ATETestPlan.xlsx"

  # Specify output path
  python -m teststand.agents.excel_to_seq "D:\\Templates\\ATETestPlan.xlsx" -o "D:\\Output\\Test.seq"

  # Verbose output
  python -m teststand.agents.excel_to_seq "D:\\Templates\\ATETestPlan.xlsx" -v
        """
    )
    parser.add_argument("excel_file", type=str, help="Path to ATETestPlan Excel file")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=str,
                       help="Output .seq file path (default: <excel_file>.seq)")
    parser.add_argument("-s", "--sequence-name", type=str, default="MainSequence",
                       help="Main sequence name (default: MainSequence)")
    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true",
                       help="Enable verbose output")
    return parser


def main():
    parser = create_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()

    excel_file = Path(args.excel_file)
    if not excel_file.exists():
        print(f"Error: Excel file not found: {excel_file}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Determine output path
    if args.output:
        output_path = Path(args.output)
    else:
        output_path = excel_file.with_suffix('.seq')

    if args.verbose:
        print(f"Parsing Excel file: {excel_file}")
        print(f"Output will be saved to: {output_path}")

    try:
        # Parse Excel
        parser = ExcelParser()
        test_cases, vi_params, variables = parser.parse(str(excel_file))

        if args.verbose:
            print(f"Parsed {len(test_cases)} test cases")
            print(f"Parsed {len(vi_params)} VI parameter entries")
            print(f"Parsed {len(variables)} variables")

        # Generate sequence file
        generator = SeqGenerator()
        generator.generate(test_cases, vi_params, str(output_path), args.sequence_name,
                          variables=variables)

        print(f"\nSequence file generated successfully!")
        print(f"  Sequence name: {args.sequence_name}")
        print(f"  Test cases: {len(test_cases)}")
        print(f"  Output: {output_path}")

        sys.exit(0)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        if args.verbose:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
